class ResultEnvelope:
    ok: bool
    complete: bool
    source: str
    auth: dict[str, Any]
    failureClass: str | None = None
    retryAfter: int | None = None
    rateLimit: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    message: str | None = None
    data: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "complete": self.complete,
            "source": self.source,
            "failureClass": self.failureClass,
            "retryAfter": self.retryAfter,
            "rateLimit": self.rateLimit,
            "auth": self.auth,
        }
        if self.message:
            payload["message"] = self.message
        payload.update(self.data)
        return payload

    @property
    def exit_code(self) -> int:
        if self.ok:
            return 0
        return EXIT_CODES.get(str(self.failureClass or FailureClass.TRANSPORT), 75)

class PrCreateReceiptRead:
    """Projection of ResultEnvelope; acceptance alone does not supply identity."""

    accepted: bool
    url: Any
    output: Any
    diagnostics: tuple[str, ...]

def read_pr_create_receipt(value: object) -> PrCreateReceiptRead:
    producer = "agent_os_github_adapter.create_pr"
    if isinstance(value, ResultEnvelope):
        value = value.to_dict()
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            value = json.loads(value)
        except ValueError:
            return PrCreateReceiptRead(False, "", "", (f"{producer}: $ invalid JSON",))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return PrCreateReceiptRead(False, "", "", (f"{producer}: $ invalid; expected object",))
    diagnostics = []
    accepted = value.get("ok") is True
    if not accepted:
        diagnostics.append(
            f"{producer}: ok={value.get('ok')!r}; failureClass={value.get('failureClass')!r}"
        )
    if accepted and (not isinstance(value.get("url"), str) or not value["url"]):
        diagnostics.append(f"{producer}: url missing/invalid after remote acceptance")
    return PrCreateReceiptRead(
        accepted, value.get("url") or "", value.get("output") or "", tuple(diagnostics)
    )
